ENARFR

A local AI assistant for Arabic

An experiment in running an assistant on-device with Arabic text and speech. It combines a local language model with tools for carrying out tasks.

GitHub profile

Example: creating a file in Arabic

Imagine asking the assistant to create a text file containing «أهلًا من بانياس».

  1. The assistant uses a local tool to create the file.
  2. The check reads the file back and compares its content with the requested text.
  3. If the file is missing or the content differs, the assistant can retry within a set limit and report the actual outcome.
